_doc.about: Example Cutpoint settings. Copy to <CUTPOINT_HOME>\config.json (run `cutpoint paths` to see where that is) and keep only the keys you need; every key is optional. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
_doc.projects_dir: Folder for project folders. A bare project name (my-trip) or projects\<name> argument is placed here. Env CUTPOINT_PROJECTS_DIR overrides it. Default: <CUTPOINT_HOME>\projects.
_doc.source_remap: {old prefix: new prefix}. Point old paths at a new location when footage moves (another drive, a backup copy): a source under an old prefix is read from the new prefix when the file exists there. Projects and cache keys keep the original path, so nothing has to be re-analysed.
_doc.source_remap_exclude: File-name or full-path globs that are never remapped (e.g. a copy that is not verified yet).
_doc.stage_dir: Local folder for `cutpoint stage` copies of sources on slow or network storage (NAS, USB, cloud-synced folder). Env CUTPOINT_STAGE_DIR overrides it. Default: <CUTPOINT_HOME>\stage.
_doc.player_tags: Your in-game name(s) for the optional game-HUD OCR in `cutpoint events` (who killed whom). Fuzzy match, ignores _ . - and spaces. `cutpoint events --player NAME` overrides it per run. Default: none.
_doc.ollama_url: Ollama base URL for `analyze --vision`, the VLM layer of `cutpoint events`, `360 director --vl-check`, the AI Chat and activity profiles. Env OLLAMA_HOST overrides it. Default: http://127.0.0.1:11434.
_doc.vision: true or false (default). true: `cutpoint analyze` and `cutpoint edit` rate the top candidates with the vision model unless --no-vision is given (slower; uses several GB of GPU memory). false: only --vision turns it on for one run. The UI's Models tab writes it, and every analysis the UI starts passes it as --vision or --no-vision.
_doc.visual_index: true or false (default). true: `cutpoint analyze` and `cutpoint edit` also write the CLIP frame embeddings that the AI Chat's visual search reads for gaming, funny and commentary footage (action, sport and action-cam always have them), unless --no-visual-index is given. Changes no ranking; costs GPU time and needs the events extra. See docs/configuration.md#visual_index.
_doc.ocr_det_skip: true or false (default). true: the HUD text reading of `cutpoint analyze`, `cutpoint edit` and `cutpoint events` skips the text detection on a screen region that has not changed since it last ran there, unless --no-ocr-det-skip is given (faster on gameplay with a still HUD; the first run reads the footage again). `events` uses the setting the analysis used. See docs/configuration.md#ocr_det_skip.
_doc.vision_assistant: Frame-rating role, independent of assistant: provider = ollama (default), claude-code, codex or antigravity; model, url and consent as in docs/configuration.md#vision_assistant. Hosted catalogs and frames require role-specific consent (consent = vision-v2:<provider>@<host> entries; unprefixed entries from older versions no longer count). Activity detection always uses Ollama.
_doc.compress_peaks: off (default), light or strong: peak compression and clip leveling of `cutpoint clips`, `assemble` and `edit` when --compress-peaks is not given (see docs/commands.md#peak-compression).
_doc.color: off (default), auto or underwater: automatic color correction of `cutpoint clips` and `edit` when --color is not given (see docs/commands.md#clips). Never applied to gaming footage (only --color grades it) nor together with --lut.
_doc.analysis: {"skip": [...]}: analysis steps `cutpoint analyze` and `cutpoint edit` leave out by default; any of reactions, keyframes and crashes. --skip overrides it per run. Default: none.
_doc.video_encoder: auto, nvenc, amf, vaapi or cpu (libx264). Env CUTPOINT_VIDEO_ENCODER overrides it. auto really encodes a short test clip with each GPU encoder and uses the first that works, else libx264; a named GPU encoder that does not work is an error. `cutpoint capabilities` shows what works. Default: auto.
_doc.memory_guard: GB of RAM left free when a model loads; 0 turns the memory guard off (see docs/commands.md#memory-guard). Default: 2.
_doc.export_workers: auto or 1-3: how many clips `cutpoint clips` and `edit` export at once. Env CUTPOINT_EXPORT_WORKERS overrides it. auto uses 2 with a GPU encoder (nvenc, amf, vaapi) and 1 with libx264, which already uses every core; runs with a 360 clip always export one at a time. Default: auto.
_doc.assistant: Settings of the AI Chat tab of `cutpoint ui`; the Models tab writes them. provider = ollama (default), openai, anthropic, xai, claude-code, codex or antigravity; model (empty = the provider's default); url (empty = the provider's own); context_tokens (at least 2048); consent = assistant-v3:<provider>@<host> entries the user agreed to send project text to (unprefixed entries from older versions no longer count). Never an API key. Details and defaults: docs/configuration.md#assistant.
_doc.pano: Optional 360-camera (Insta360) module: sdk_exe = MediaSDKTest.exe of the Insta360 Media SDK, which you apply for yourself (see docs/insta360-sdk.md; env CUTPOINT_INSTA360_SDK overrides; default: auto-detected under <CUTPOINT_HOME>\sdk\insta360\); stitch_timeout_s = kill one clip's stitch after this many seconds (default: no limit); auto_stitch = cutpoint ui exports of a 360 project first stitch the recordings they need when the SDK runs and an NVIDIA GPU is present, false exports from the dual-fisheye preview; the command-line clips never stitches (default true); stitched_dir = where `cutpoint 360 stitch` writes equirects (default <CUTPOINT_HOME>\360-stitched; about 54 GB per hour of footage); studio_dirs = folders with Insta360 Studio equirect exports (default <CUTPOINT_HOME>\360-studio); stitch_args = MediaSDKTest arguments (do not add -enable_flowstate: Cutpoint levels with its own IMU track); cmd_every = update the virtual camera every N frames (default 1; 2 halves the commands but leaves shake on every other frame); level_strength = horizon lock when stabilising, 1 = always level, 0 = follow the camera's own tilt (default 0.7); tilt_follow_s = smoothing (s) of the followed tilt (default 0.5); max_follow_deg = largest lean (deg from the clip's average attitude) the view follows; a fall or handling is followed as this much (default 30); imu_offset_s = IMU-to-video time offset in seconds (default 0); equirect_yaw_offset = yaw correction in degrees for Studio exports (default 0); director = settings of `cutpoint 360 director` (see docs/configuration.md#pano); default_style = --style of `cutpoint 360 analyze` when none is given (default action-cam).
_doc.environment: Not set here: CUTPOINT_HOME, CUTPOINT_CONFIG, the other CUTPOINT_* variables, OLLAMA_HOST and the API keys of `cutpoint ui` (never put a key in this file). See docs/configuration.md#environment-variables.
